# CLI: CDN

## get-cache-status

Kind: Read.

Use generated CDN domains in CDNDomains. Analytics POST requests are allowed in
read-only mode.

| Flag                                       | Type       | Required |
| ------------------------------------------ | ---------- | -------- |
| `--period`                                 | `string`   |          |
| `--from`                                   | `string`   |          |
| `--to`                                     | `string`   |          |
| `CDNDomains` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `[]string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode cdn get-cache-status --cli-input-json '{"CDNDomains":["<cdn-domain>"]}' --period 24h
```

## get-certificate

Kind: Read.

Returns the certificate and CA chain as PEM text.

| Flag               | Type     | Required |
| ------------------ | -------- | -------- |
| `--certificate-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode cdn get-certificate --certificate-id <certificate-id> --query Certificate
```
